items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Pat, they got drunk... About five or six of them went out there drinking.

ctx.x: Was Lester in the band at that time?

No, no. This was Bronson's band. This was the band and he was taking it over. It was the first night that it was under King's name. Pat, they got drunk... About five or six of them went out there drinking. They had a drink out there in Kansas they called chalk, and something like (?). So it would make you higher than four buildings. High up there. So these cats all before the dance went to this cat's house that made it. And he made us all high. Now, Francis Whitby, he got so drunk that he was on the bandstand...…
